name: Enterprise Financial Compliance Policy
description: Standard compliance rules for invoices and contracts

rules.name: Maximum Invoice Amount
rules.message: Invoice amount exceeds $50,000 threshold. Requires VP approval.

rules.name: Valid Invoice Date
rules.message: Invoice date cannot be in the future.

rules.name: Approved Vendor List
rules.message: Vendor not found in approved vendor list.

rules.name: Warranty Clause Required
rules.message: Contract must include warranty and liability clauses.

rules.name: Purchase Order Match
rules.message: Invoice must reference a valid Purchase Order number.
